```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide")

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
has_input_file <- !is.null(input_file) &&
  length(input_file) > 0 &&
  !is.na(input_file) &&
  nzchar(input_file)

if (has_input_file) {
  input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
  project_dir <- if (basename(input_dir) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    normalizePath(input_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  }
} else {
  cwd <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  project_dir <- if (basename(cwd) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(cwd, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    cwd
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
setwd(project_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tximport)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(Mfuzz)
  library(Biobase)
  library(scales)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(jsonlite)
})


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

rdata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "RData")
dir.create(rdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rds_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
}

cache_or_run <- function(name, expr, refresh = FALSE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (file.exists(path) && !refresh) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("Running and saving object: ", path)
    value <- force(expr)
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
  }
}

load_rds_object <- function(name, required = TRUE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing cached object: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  readRDS(path)
}

load_rds_list <- function(name, required = TRUE, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  value <- load_rds_object(name, required = required)
  if (!is.null(value)) list2env(value, envir = envir)
  invisible(value)
}

analysis_file <- function(...) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
}

input_file_path <- function(...) {
  cached <- file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
  if (file.exists(cached)) return(cached)
  file.path(project_dir, ...)
}

show_table <- function(x, n = 20, title = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    cat("\n### ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No object available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No rows.\n")
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  print(utils::head(df, n))
  invisible(df)
}

show_plot_files <- function(paths) {
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  paths <- normalizePath(paths, mustWork = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
}
```

```{r load-upstream}
load_rds_list("01_deseq_lrt")
load_rds_list("02_significant_nlr")
load_rds_list("03_vst_expression")
load_rds_list("04_mfuzz_clusters")
gene_module_df <- load_rds_object("06_gene_module_df")
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Step 1. Build NLR master table and analyze TNL/CNL/RNL only
############################################################


## -----------------------------
## 0. Basic settings
## -----------------------------

tcr_levels <- c("TNL", "CNL", "RNL")

to_atomic_chr <- function(x) {
  if (is.list(x)) {
    purrr::map_chr(x, ~ paste(as.character(unlist(.x)), collapse = ";"))
  } else {
    as.character(x)
  }
}


## -----------------------------
## 1. Check required objects/files
## -----------------------------

# res <- results(dds_lrt)
if (!exists("res")) {
  stop("Cannot find object 'res'. Please run DESeq2 LRT first and create object: res <- results(dds_lrt)")
}

mfuzz_file <- analysis_file("NLR_Mfuzz_clusters.csv")
if (!file.exists(mfuzz_file) && !exists("cluster_results")) {
  stop("Cannot find 'NLR_Mfuzz_clusters.csv' or object 'cluster_results'. Please finish Mfuzz clustering first.")
}

if (!exists("gene_module_df")) {
  if (exists("moduleColors") && exists("wgcna_data")) {
    gene_module_df <- tibble(
      Gene = colnames(wgcna_data),
      Module = as.character(moduleColors)
    )
    message("gene_module_df was created from moduleColors and colnames(wgcna_data).")
  } else {
    stop("Cannot find gene_module_df. Please finish WGCNA and prepare a data frame with columns: Gene, Module.")
  }
}


## -----------------------------
## 2. Read NLR gene list
## -----------------------------


cat("NLR list genes:", length(nlr_list), "\n")


## -----------------------------
## 3. Read NLR structural classification
## -----------------------------

nlr_type <- read_tsv(
  "NLR_classification.tsv",
  col_names = c("Gene", "RawClass"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim(),
    RawClass = as.character(RawClass) %>% str_trim() %>% str_to_upper(),
    Type = case_when(
      RawClass %in% c("TNL", "CNL", "RNL") ~ RawClass,
      TRUE ~ "non_TCR"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("NLR type file genes:", nrow(nlr_type), "\n")
cat("Matched with gene.list:", sum(nlr_type$Gene %in% nlr_list), "\n")
cat("Genes in gene.list but not in classification file:", sum(!nlr_list %in% nlr_type$Gene), "\n")


## -----------------------------
## 4. Prepare DESeq2 LRT result
## -----------------------------

res_lrt <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  mutate(Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim()) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, baseMean, stat, pvalue, padj) %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)


## -----------------------------
## 5. Prepare Mfuzz cluster result
## -----------------------------

if (file.exists(mfuzz_file)) {
  mfuzz_cluster <- read_csv(
    mfuzz_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
} else {
  mfuzz_cluster <- as_tibble(cluster_results)
}

if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(mfuzz_cluster)) {
  colnames(mfuzz_cluster)[1] <- "Gene"
}

if (!"Cluster" %in% colnames(mfuzz_cluster)) {
  possible_cluster_cols <- c("cluster", "Mfuzz_cluster", "mfuzz_cluster", "Cluster_ID", "cluster_id")
  matched_cluster_col <- intersect(possible_cluster_cols, colnames(mfuzz_cluster))
  
  if (length(matched_cluster_col) >= 1) {
    mfuzz_cluster <- mfuzz_cluster %>%
      rename(Cluster = all_of(matched_cluster_col[1]))
  } else {
    stop("Cannot identify Cluster column in Mfuzz result. Please make sure it has a column named 'Cluster'.")
  }
}

mfuzz_cluster <- mfuzz_cluster %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim(),
    Cluster = to_atomic_chr(Cluster),
    Cluster = na_if(Cluster, "")
  ) %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Cluster)


## -----------------------------
## 6. Prepare WGCNA module result
## -----------------------------

gene_module_df_clean <- as_tibble(gene_module_df)

if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(gene_module_df_clean)) {
  colnames(gene_module_df_clean)[1] <- "Gene"
}

if (!"Module" %in% colnames(gene_module_df_clean)) {
  possible_module_cols <- c("module", "ModuleColor", "moduleColor", "colors", "moduleColors")
  matched_module_col <- intersect(possible_module_cols, colnames(gene_module_df_clean))
  
  if (length(matched_module_col) >= 1) {
    gene_module_df_clean <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
      rename(Module = all_of(matched_module_col[1]))
  } else {
    colnames(gene_module_df_clean)[2] <- "Module"
  }
}

gene_module_df_clean <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim(),
    Module = to_atomic_chr(Module),
    Module = na_if(Module, "")
  ) %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Module)


## -----------------------------
## 7. Expression matrix gene check
## -----------------------------

if (exists("expr_matrix")) {
  expr_genes <- rownames(expr_matrix)
  if (is.null(expr_genes)) {
    expr_genes <- character(0)
  }
} else {
  expr_genes <- character(0)
  message("Object 'expr_matrix' was not found. In_expr_matrix will be FALSE for all genes.")
}


## -----------------------------
## 8. Build NLR master table
## -----------------------------

nlr_master_all <- tibble(Gene = nlr_list) %>%
  distinct(Gene) %>%
  left_join(nlr_type, by = "Gene") %>%
  left_join(res_lrt, by = "Gene") %>%
  left_join(mfuzz_cluster, by = "Gene") %>%
  left_join(gene_module_df_clean, by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(
    RawClass = replace_na(RawClass, "Missing_class"),
    Type = replace_na(Type, "non_TCR"),
    
    In_DESeq2 = Gene %in% res_lrt$Gene,
    In_expr_matrix = Gene %in% expr_genes,
    Has_padj = !is.na(padj),
    
    DE_LRT = case_when(
      Has_padj & padj < 0.05 ~ TRUE,
      Has_padj & padj >= 0.05 ~ FALSE,
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )

nlr_master_TCR <- nlr_master_all %>%
  filter(Type %in% tcr_levels) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    Cluster = as.character(Cluster),
    Module = as.character(Module)
  )

nlr_master <- nlr_master_TCR

write_tsv(
  nlr_master,
  analysis_file("NLR_master_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv")
)


## -----------------------------
## 9. Basic check of TNL/CNL/RNL master table
## -----------------------------

cat("\n===== TNL/CNL/RNL master table check =====\n")
cat("TNL/CNL/RNL genes:", nrow(nlr_master), "\n")
cat("TNL/CNL/RNL genes with padj:", sum(nlr_master$Has_padj), "\n")
cat("TNL/CNL/RNL DE genes by LRT:", sum(nlr_master$DE_LRT == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

print(
  nlr_master %>%
    dplyr::count(Type, name = "Total_NLR")
)

print(
  nlr_master %>%
    summarise(
      Total_TCR_NLR = n(),
      In_expr_matrix = sum(In_expr_matrix),
      In_DESeq2 = sum(In_DESeq2),
      Has_padj = sum(Has_padj),
      DE_LRT = sum(DE_LRT == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
)


## -----------------------------
## 10. A. DE ratio by TNL/CNL/RNL
## -----------------------------

type_total_TCR <- nlr_master %>%
  dplyr::count(Type, name = "Total_NLR")

type_tested_TCR <- nlr_master %>%
  filter(Has_padj) %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(
    Tested_NLR = n(),
    DE_NLR = sum(DE_LRT == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    DE_ratio = DE_NLR / Tested_NLR,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

type_de_summary_TCR <- type_total_TCR %>%
  left_join(type_tested_TCR, by = "Type") %>%
  mutate(
    Tested_NLR = replace_na(Tested_NLR, 0L),
    DE_NLR = replace_na(DE_NLR, 0L),
    DE_ratio = if_else(Tested_NLR > 0, DE_NLR / Tested_NLR, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Type)

cat("\n===== DE summary: TNL/CNL/RNL =====\n")
print(type_de_summary_TCR)

write_tsv(
  type_de_summary_TCR,
  analysis_file("NLR_type_DE_summary_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv")
)


## -----------------------------
## 11. B. TNL/CNL/RNL × Mfuzz cluster
## -----------------------------

cluster_values <- nlr_master %>%
  filter(DE_LRT == TRUE, !is.na(Cluster)) %>%
  pull(Cluster) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

if (length(cluster_values) > 0) {
  
  type_cluster_table_TCR <- nlr_master %>%
    filter(DE_LRT == TRUE, !is.na(Cluster)) %>%
    mutate(
      Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
      Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = cluster_values)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::count(Type, Cluster, name = "NLR_count", .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(Type) %>%
    mutate(
      Type_total_in_clusters = sum(NLR_count),
      Within_type_ratio = ifelse(
        Type_total_in_clusters > 0,
        NLR_count / Type_total_in_clusters,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Type, Cluster)
  
} else {
  
  type_cluster_table_TCR <- tibble(
    Type = factor(character(), levels = tcr_levels),
    Cluster = character(),
    NLR_count = integer(),
    Type_total_in_clusters = integer(),
    Within_type_ratio = numeric()
  )
  
  message("No DE TNL/CNL/RNL genes with Mfuzz Cluster were found.")
}

cat("\n===== TNL/CNL/RNL x Mfuzz cluster =====\n")
print(type_cluster_table_TCR)

write_tsv(
  type_cluster_table_TCR,
  analysis_file("NLR_type_Mfuzz_cluster_summary_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv")
)


## -----------------------------
## 12. C. TNL/CNL/RNL × WGCNA module
## -----------------------------

type_module_table_TCR <- nlr_master %>%
  filter(DE_LRT == TRUE, !is.na(Module)) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    Module = as.character(Module)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(Type, Module, name = "NLR_count") %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  mutate(
    Type_total_in_modules = sum(NLR_count),
    Within_type_ratio = NLR_count / Type_total_in_modules
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Type, desc(NLR_count), Module)

cat("\n===== TNL/CNL/RNL x WGCNA module =====\n")
print(type_module_table_TCR)

write_tsv(
  type_module_table_TCR,
  analysis_file("NLR_type_WGCNA_module_summary_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv")
)


## -----------------------------
## 13. D. Fisher test: Type vs DE status
## -----------------------------

type_de_mat_TCR_df <- nlr_master %>%
  filter(Has_padj) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    DE_status = if_else(DE_LRT == TRUE, "DE", "nonDE")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(Type, DE_status, name = "n") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Type = factor(tcr_levels, levels = tcr_levels),
    DE_status = c("DE", "nonDE"),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = DE_status,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(Type)

type_de_mat_TCR <- type_de_mat_TCR_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("Type") %>%
  as.matrix()

type_de_mat_TCR <- type_de_mat_TCR[, c("DE", "nonDE"), drop = FALSE]

cat("\n===== Fisher test matrix: TNL/CNL/RNL =====\n")
print(type_de_mat_TCR)

fisher_TCR <- fisher.test(type_de_mat_TCR)

cat("\n===== Fisher test result: TNL/CNL/RNL =====\n")
print(fisher_TCR)

write_tsv(
  type_de_mat_TCR_df,
  analysis_file("NLR_type_DE_matrix_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv")
)

capture.output(
  fisher_TCR,
  file = analysis_file("Fisher_test_NLR_type_DE_TNL_CNL_RNL.txt")
)


## -----------------------------
## 14. Standardized residuals
## -----------------------------

chisq_TCR <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(type_de_mat_TCR))

stdres_TCR <- as.data.frame(chisq_TCR$stdres) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Type") %>%
  as_tibble()

cat("\n===== Standardized residuals =====\n")
print(stdres_TCR)

write_tsv(
  stdres_TCR,
  analysis_file("NLR_type_DE_standardized_residuals_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv")
)


## -----------------------------
## 15. Save final objects for later steps
## -----------------------------

saveRDS(
  nlr_master,
  analysis_file("NLR_master_TNL_CNL_RNL.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    type_de_summary_TCR = type_de_summary_TCR,
    type_cluster_table_TCR = type_cluster_table_TCR,
    type_module_table_TCR = type_module_table_TCR,
    type_de_mat_TCR = type_de_mat_TCR,
    fisher_TCR = fisher_TCR,
    stdres_TCR = stdres_TCR
  ),
  analysis_file("NLR_TNL_CNL_RNL_structure_analysis_results.rds")
)

```

```{r display-key-results, results='markup', echo=FALSE}
show_table(type_de_summary_TCR, n = 20, title = "DE ratio by NLR structural class")
show_table(type_cluster_table_TCR, n = 30, title = "Mfuzz cluster composition by structural class")
show_table(
  type_module_table_TCR %>% dplyr::arrange(Type, dplyr::desc(NLR_count)),
  n = 30,
  title = "Top WGCNA modules by structural class"
)
show_table(stdres_TCR, n = 20, title = "Standardized residuals for Type x DE status")
```
